## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] No API keys, passwords, tokens, or `.env` files in the change.
- [ ] No real client data in code, tests, fixtures, screenshots, or documents.
- [ ] Nothing is sent to a person or outside the sandbox without an approval step (drafts only).
- [ ] The specification says what is stored, for how long, and what leaves the sandbox. The code matches it.
- [ ] Tests were written before the code and still check the behaviour (no tests changed just to pass).
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes for the whole repository.
- [ ] New outside providers, keys, or shared database tables were approved by a developer.
- [ ] Personal data is deleted on the schedule in the specification.
